description: Don’t rush if it’s not necessary #selflove #selfcare #selfimprovement
transcript: Slow and steady always wins the race. Move with intention. I move with stillness. I move slowly. I know when to pick up the pace. I'm very mindful. One wrong step and you can step into something icky. I pay attention to what's going on around me because everyone else is rushing. Slow and steady keeps me meticulous and riding at the 30,000 foot level.
